name: PantryPal
one_liner: Snap a photo of your fridge to get three recipes based on your ingredients.
problem: Deciding what to cook with available ingredients at home can be frustrating and leads to wasted food.
audience: Home cooks looking to make meals with whatever ingredients they already have in their fridge.

features.name: Fridge Photo Ingredient Detection
features.description: Detects available food ingredients from a single photo of your open fridge.

features.name: Recipe Suggestions
features.description: Recommends three recipes ranked by how many of your detected ingredients they use.

features.name: Missing Items Shopping List
features.description: Tracks and displays a shopping list for the missing ingredients needed for recipes.

flow.text: Open PantryPal and view the main screen.
Tap the camera button to open the camera interface.
Take a photo of the open fridge using the shutter button.
View the three suggested recipes ranked by ingredient match.
Check the shopping list for the few missing ingredients needed.
